title: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon with staged rollout to cyber defenders
description:
Google just dropped Gemini 4 Carbon for cyber defenders, but Microsoft and Google are also signaling a slowdown in infrastructure spending. We’re breaking down what this means for your tech stack and your budget.

What we covered:
• Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon with staged rollout to cyber defenders
• Google and Microsoft Delay Capital Expenditure Forecasts in Q3 Earnings
• GitHub Launches Copilot Fusion for Multi-Model AI Coding

Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways.

Listener question: If your AI coding assistant could switch models to save you money, would you trust it to pick the right one for your code?

What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules.

Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next.

What changed. Who wins. What you do next.
